$comment: Windy Clone ops surface — Class C, clean single-service replication (Mind/Search/Mail pattern, no wrinkle). Product API (orders, clones, previews, soul-file export — user-scoped, money-adjacent) stays OUT per §2. Reads bound via transport on https://windyclone.ai. get_capabilities maps to the provider catalog: a clone marketplace with ZERO providers is degraded-while-looking-alive — same honest-capability logic as Search's zero-bridges probe. Rev 2026-07-13 (gap-closing, replicating windy-mind #60 / windy-search #61 / windy-mail #84): get_logs + get_config + run_selftest SHIPPED as the /ops/* trio (auth: Clone's own citizens dependency — Pro JWT). get_logs is content-free BY CONSTRUCTION (fixed vocabulary; never a clone name, identity, audio metadata, or raw provider text). get_config surfaces DEV_MODE explicitly — in production that flag is an auth bypass and the FIRST thing to check. run_selftest resolves + prices a DUMMY order through the provider registry (the exact decision path order-creation takes) plus a DB round-trip — NO provider API call, NO order row, NO purchase; verdict 60s-cached, `passed` per the invoke-envelope rule. Mutating gaps: port the windy-mind ops-hook (#61) to the Clone EC2. DEPLOY STATUS: merged; live after the Grant-gated deploy — probe before trusting mid-incident.

get_status.note: full deployment identity: version, commit sha, build timestamp, started_at, environment.

get_capabilities.note: the provider catalog IS the capability probe — zero providers = degraded marketplace.

get_config.note: provider keys + identity/OAuth/Eternitas/soul-signing wiring as booleans, plus the DEV_MODE flag (auth bypass if on in prod) — closed 2026-07-13.

get_logs.note: content-free ring, fixed vocabulary; never voice samples or soul-file content — closed 2026-07-13.

run_selftest.note: resolves + prices a dummy elevenlabs order via the registry + DB round-trip; NO purchase, NO order row; 60s cache — closed 2026-07-13.

restart_app.note: out-of-band; port the windy-mind ops-hook (windy-mind #61 — out-of-patient systemd unit, bearer + confirm nonce) to the Clone EC2.

check_for_update.note: resolves the running version against admin's /v1/fleet-versions; status + literal remediation. Closed 2026-07-13.

apply_update.note: SSH-free health-gated redeploy; §7. The windy-mind ops-hook (#61: rebuild + last-good rollback + sha attestation) is the pattern to port.

reset_to_defaults.note: NEVER — holds users' clone orders and soul-file exports.

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: The FIRST call when Windy Clone seems down. Liveness of the clone service: returns healthy + service + version if the API process is up.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Read Windy Clone's deployment identity — which build is serving right now, its commit, when it started, and which environment. Use this to confirm a deploy actually landed.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: List the clone providers Windy Clone can actually offer right now, with their pricing and features. A clone marketplace with zero providers looks alive but can't sell anything — this is the honest capability probe. Optionally filter by provider type.

type.description: Filter by provider type; omit or 'all' for everything.

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Read Windy Clone's recent operational events — server starts and self-test results by category. Content-free by construction: the log can only ever hold fixed event names and codes — never a clone name, a user identity, audio metadata, or raw provider error text. Requires your Windy account token.

entries.description: [{ts, level, event, code?}] — fixed vocabulary only

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Read Windy Clone's effective runtime configuration with every secret redacted to a boolean: which clone providers (ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Resemble) actually hold keys, whether Pro identity, OAuth, Eternitas, and soul-file signing are wired — and whether DEV_MODE is on, which in production would mean auth is bypassed and is the first thing to check. Requires your Windy account token.

dev_mode.description: TRUE in production = auth bypass — investigate immediately

tools.name: run_selftest
tools.description: Actively exercise Windy Clone's order decision path WITHOUT buying anything: resolve a dummy order through the provider registry exactly the way real order creation does (provider lookup, wiring check, public starting price) plus a real database round-trip. Nothing is created, uploaded, or charged — pass/fail per stage. Verdict cached 60 seconds. Requires your Windy account token.

passed.description: true only when every stage passed ('passed', not 'ok' — top-level ok is reserved for the invoke envelope)

tools.name: check_for_update
tools.description: Check whether a newer Windy Clone build is available. Resolves the running version against the fleet's version manifest and reports current, update-available (the notes say what it fixes), or must-update (below the minimum supported version), with the literal next step when an update exists. Read-only — never deploys; applying is the separate always-confirm apply_update.
